title: Shampoo for Thinning Hair: What Actually Helps (and What Doesn't)

seo_description: Do shampoos for thinning hair work? The ingredients worth looking for (ketoconazole, caffeine, gentle cleansers), what to avoid, and how to wash thinning hair.
summary_html: What shampoos for thinning hair can and can't do, the ingredients worth looking for, what to avoid, and how to wash thinning hair.
notes: Rebuilds the 2023 /thinning-hair-shampoo page (973 impressions) for a large, low-difficulty group of searches: 'regrow hair shampoo' (22,200 a month, KD 2), 'sulfate-free shampoo for thinning hair' (12,100, KD 1), 'best women shampoo for thinning hair' (8,100, KD 3), 'best shampoo for male thinning hair' (6,600) and 'hair thinning women shampoo' (4,400).
FullyVital doesn't sell shampoo: the page says so plainly and bridges to the leave-on Hair Revival Serum.

FAQ built from Google's 'People also ask' for 'shampoo for thinning hair': thickening shampoo for fine hair, the vitamin question, and the 70-year-old woman question, plus whether hair loss shampoos work, sulfate-free, and daily washing.
3 studies: ketoconazole shampoo (1998), caffeine shampoo follicle penetration (2007), and a 2002 review on shedding and washing frequency.
